workbench.label: WORKBENCH
workbench.description: WORKBENCH — grants the room's agent shell + verify, so it can run and test real code. Pair it with a workstation in the same room.

intake.label: INBOX
intake.description: Your floor is a flowchart — work arrives at the INBOX, every BAY is an agent doing one step, and the belts you draw are the order the work flows. OUTSIDE work (a DM, a routine) arrives here and drops onto a belt. Orders you give in COMMS skip it — they land straight at the agent's BAY. You don't need one for an agent to work — a BAY alone is enough; the inbox is for watching outside work ride in.

bay.label: BAY
bay.description: BAY — the agent dock. Click it, assign an agent — done: work for that agent lands here, no belts required. Add belts to watch work ride in from an INBOX (and finished work ride out to an OUTBOX). The props in its room become its powers.

filter.label: FILTER
filter.description: FILTER — sorts UNADDRESSED work by its content, sending each kind down a different belt lane. Work already bound to an agent rides straight home past it. Click it to set the routes.

merger.label: MERGER
merger.description: MERGER — a lane funnel: several belt lanes converge into one, and every crate rides straight on (K in, K out). It tidies the lanes — it never combines the jobs riding them; each still runs on its own. Nothing to configure.

splitter.label: SPLITTER
splitter.description: SPLITTER — fans one work stream across its lanes to run several agents in parallel (load-balance).

joiner.label: JOINER
joiner.description: JOINER — the fan-in barrier. Every lane feeding it is a branch of the same job: it HOLDS each branch's result until all of them have arrived (or 10 minutes pass), then sends ONE merged crate on, each branch's output clearly labelled. Draw a SPLITTER upstream and its lanes run in parallel instead of taking turns.

loop.label: LOOP
loop.description: LOOP — the gate that makes a cycle legal. Belt its BACK lane to an upstream dock and its DONE lane onward: work goes round again (up to 5 passes by default, 20 at most), then leaves on DONE. Spend stays inside the line's dollar cap. Any cycle without a LOOP is still refused.

outbox.label: OUTBOX
outbox.description: OUTBOX — the dispatch chute where an agent's finished reply leaves the station. Click it to read and rate every finished run waiting for you.

connector_portal.label: CONNECTOR
connector_portal.description: CONNECTOR — bind an MCP server here to grant the room's agent that server's live tools. Click it to bind one.

comms_dish.label: DISH
comms_dish.description: CAPABILITY — gives the agent in this room web access (live search & fetch).

core.label: CORE
core.description: CAPABILITY — gives the agent in this room long-term memory AND its skill library (a notebook it recalls facts from, and where it saves & reloads reusable skills).

gigs_servercart.description: CAPABILITY — gives the agent in this room long-term memory AND its skill library (a notebook it recalls facts from, and where it saves & reloads reusable skills).

studio.label: STUDIO
studio.description: CAPABILITY — gives the agent in this room a media studio (generate & analyze images). It glows magenta while an image renders.

airlock.label: AIRLOCK
airlock.description: AIRLOCK — seals a room on the floor (a staging / merge gate); the agent's body can't path in or out. Click to cycle open / sealed / jammed.

missionboard.label: MISSION BOARD
missionboard.description: MISSION BOARD — the quest log made physical. Every pinned card is a real open quest; click the board to read them. It suggests, never gates.

trophycase.label: TROPHY CASE
trophycase.description: TROPHY CASE — the station's real achievements made permanent. Earned milestones, completed quests, and your living tools stand behind glass; click to open the case. It grants nothing — it remembers.

bridge_consolebank.label: BRIDGE CONSOLE BANK
bridge_consolebank.description: Decorative instrument bank with cyan navigation displays. Fits against a north wall; grants no tools.

bridge_tacticaltable.label: TACTICAL TABLE
bridge_tacticaltable.description: Decorative octagonal navigation table in worn steel and dark cyan glass.

bridge_equipmentbay.label: EQUIPMENT BAY
bridge_equipmentbay.description: Decorative armored equipment cabinet with brass handles and recessed instruments.

bridge_deckperimeter.label: DECK PERIMETER
bridge_deckperimeter.description: Worn hazard perimeter painted on the deck. Walkable; furniture may stand inside or across it.
